title: Fix 3 buggy Go stack implementation methods
description: Greenfield Go dirty scenario: a stack data structure has 3 broken methods. Fix Pop, Peek, and IsEmpty so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 buggy methods in internal/stack/stack.go so all tests pass.

  func (s *Stack) Pop() (int, bool)
    — remove and return the TOP (last added) element, not the first

  func (s *Stack) Peek() (int, bool)
    — return the TOP element without removing it

  func (s *Stack) IsEmpty() bool
    — return true only when len(s.items) == 0

Do not modify the test file.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Pop returns the last-in element (LIFO order)
Peek returns last-in element without removing
IsEmpty returns true only for empty stack
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
